facts.text: Snow left Rubicon #2 (7,560 ft) and Echo Peak (7,650 ft) 24 to 35 days earlier this year than the median of the three earlier seasons on file (2023 to 2025).

evidence.name: Rubicon #2
evidence.detail: left April 24; earlier seasons: June 16 (2023), May 29 (2024), May 23 (2025)

evidence.name: Echo Peak
evidence.detail: left April 23; earlier seasons: June 15 (2023), May 17 (2024), May 15 (2025)

facts.text: This year's highest snow water on or after April 1 was the lowest of the four seasons on file (2023 to 2026) at Rubicon #2 (7,560 ft) and Echo Peak (7,650 ft).

evidence.name: Rubicon #2
evidence.detail: 2.2 in on April 12; earlier seasons: 59.6 in (2023), 28.3 in (2024), 23.7 in (2025)

evidence.name: Echo Peak
evidence.detail: 4.0 in on April 12; earlier seasons: 89.7 in (2023), 41.2 in (2024), 41.0 in (2025)

facts.text: An estimate: snow left the pass itself between April 14 and June 14, carried from the melt-out dates at Rubicon #2 (7,560 ft) and Echo Peak (7,650 ft) to the pass elevation.

evidence.name: Rubicon #2
evidence.detail: melted out April 24, 1,250 ft below the pass; points to April 15 to June 16

evidence.name: Echo Peak
evidence.detail: melted out April 23, 1,160 ft below the pass; points to April 13 to June 12
